Beta moments and endpoint gamma product follow exactly. Standalone exact-rational recurrences checked 952 deterministic finite computations, supplementing the proof.

value.rationale: The physically motivated marginal transition had critical mean-square scaling and numerical Binder data but lacked a complete joint limiting law. The new result yields a universal critical bulk profile, exact Binder crossing level, conditional terminal-heading response and shape regimes, valid for all independent reversal schedules with kp_k -> c. Exact finite-step endpoint peak masses quantify how apparent ballistic atoms disappear. This is a natural distributional classification of a transport critical point, not a mere restatement of stationary beta normalization.
